examples.english: You should think about how to use your money from when you're young.

notes:
{金|かね} is the everyday, somewhat casual word for money.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {金|かね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧/⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to have/not have money)
- {金|かね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to spend money)
- {金|かね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貯|た}める→貯める：27801_tameru⟧ (to save money)
- {金|かね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay money)
- {金|かね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りる→借りる：00532_kariru⟧ (to borrow money)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧ (money - polite form)
- ⟦{金持|かねも}ち→金持ち：02993_kanemochi⟧ (rich person)
- ⟦{金|かね}づかい→金遣い：10449_kanezukai⟧ (spending habits)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {金|かね}/⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧: money (everyday)
- ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧: cash (as opposed to card)
- ⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧: funds, capital (business)

NOTE: ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧ with the お prefix is more polite and commonly used.
